description: Public X (Twitter) profiles for up to 10 usernames via the free FxTwitter API (open-source relay of X's public profile data; X's own API is paid): user ID, name, bio with expanded links, location, website, join date, protected flag, verification (verified + type: individual, business, government), followers, following, posts, likes, media count, avatar and banner. Unknown or suspended usernames go to notFound. Usually answers in a few seconds, up to 26 s on slower calls; allow a 45 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_x_com when you need One public X post by URL or ID from the JSON behind X's; social_instagram_related_profiles when you need Accounts Instagram suggests as related to a public profile. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

usernames.description: 1 to 10 X usernames, comma separated, with or without @ (x.com/<user> URLs accepted)
